title: Canonical Undo Pattern
purpose: Demonstrate old-value logging before mutation, LIFO undo reversal within checkpoint boundaries, and undo notification sequencing (clearTurn → refreshUI → refreshHand).
context: An undo flow for a resource spend action. The player spent 2 wood on a card, then undoes the action. The undo log recorded the old values; the undo reverses them in LIFO order; notifications restore the client state.
before: function spend($playerId, $type, $qty) { self::DbQuery("UPDATE resource SET qty = qty - $qty WHERE player_id = $playerId AND type = '$type'"); } function undoSpend($playerId, $type, $qty) { self::DbQuery("UPDATE resource SET qty = qty + $qty WHERE player_id = $playerId AND type = '$type'"); }
after: // START: Checkpoint established at action boundary function spend(Game $game, int $playerId, string $type, int $qty): void { $old = $game->db->get("SELECT qty FROM resource WHERE player_id = $playerId AND type = $type"); $game->db->update("UPDATE resource SET qty = qty - $qty WHERE player_id = $playerId AND type = $type AND qty >= $qty"); $game->db->insert('undo_log', ['player_id' => $playerId, 'table_name' => 'resource', 'row_id' => "{$playerId}_{$type}", 'field' => 'qty', 'old_value' => $old->qty, 'new_value' => $old->qty - $qty, 'checkpoint' => $game->getCurrentCheckpoint()]); } // UNDO: Reverses LIFO within checkpoint function undoCheckpoint(Game $game, int $checkpoint): void { $entries = $game->db->getAll("SELECT * FROM undo_log WHERE checkpoint = $checkpoint AND cancelled = 0 ORDER BY id DESC"); foreach ($entries as $entry) { $game->db->update("UPDATE {$entry['table_name']} SET {$entry['field']} = {$entry['old_value']} WHERE id = '{$entry['row_id']}'"); $game->db->update("UPDATE undo_log SET cancelled = 1 WHERE id = {$entry['id']}"); } } // NOTIFY: clearTurn → refreshUI → refreshHand function notifyUndo(Game $game): void { $game->notifications->clearTurn($game); $game->notifications->refreshUI($game, $game->getAllDatas()); foreach ($game->getActivePlayers() as $playerId) { $game->notifications->refreshHand($game, $playerId, $game->cardManager->getPlayerHand($playerId)); } }
explanation: Every mutation records old values to the undo_log table before writing new state (UNDO-001). The undo reverses mutations in LIFO order within checkpoint boundaries (UNDO-002). Checkpoints are created at each logical commit boundary (UNDO-003). The undo log marks entries as cancelled rather than deleting them (UNDO-004). After undo completes, notifications fire in order: clearTurn first to reset pending state, then refreshUI for public state, then refreshHand per-player for private state (UNDO-010, UNDO-011). This ordering follows SYNC-006 through SYNC-008.
common_mistakes: Not recording old values before mutation (undo cannot reconstruct previous state)
Reversing in FIFO instead of LIFO order (wrong state after multi-step undo)
Deleting undo log entries instead of marking them cancelled (loses audit trail)
Sending refreshUI and refreshHand without clearTurn first (stale UI indicators)
Omitting undo logging for some mutation paths (inconsistent undo behavior)

annotations.reason: Old value read and logged before mutation.
Checkpoint ID recorded for grouped undo.
LIFO order: ORDER BY id DESC reverses most recent first.
Cancelled flag keeps audit trail instead of deleting.
clearTurn first, then refreshUI, then refreshHand.
